info.name: Dr. De Lang, the Missing Alchemist

descriptions.inProgress: With a sad, yet calm look on his face, #p2111002# did not look like someone that would scare off other people by conducting terrible experiments. Observing the words he candidly spoke, I realized that his wife was #b#p2111004##k! He said he wanted to give Phyllia a #bSilver Pendant#k... \n\n ...A Silver Pendant? Come to think of it, didn't #p2040050# say something like the key to #p2111002#'s secret note is made out of silver? I can't believe that pendant has been lying around in #p2111002#'s house...
descriptions.completed: Thanks to #p2111006#'s amazing abilities, I was able to talk to #p2111002#.
